verse: You see, at just the right time, when we were still powerless, Christ died for the ungodly.
I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; no one will snatch them out of my hand.
God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
The LORD is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
The LORD appeared to us in the past, saying: “I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness.”
I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions, for my own sake, and remembers your sins no more.
I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God so that you may know that you have eternal life.
hook: Can you be sure of heaven?

verse: She will give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.
And so we know and rely on the love God has for us. God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.
I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
sub: He gave His life for you.

verse: The LORD is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life—of whom shall I be afraid?
And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good. His love endures forever.
Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.
